leadText:
Mr. Big (Japanese: ハナビシ Hanabishi) is a character of the day who appeared in Now That's Flower Power!.

Mr. Big lives in Slateport City. He specializes in making Pokémon-themed with crushed , using different kinds in order to make various colors. Mr. Big was a former , having a total of three Ribbons.

After had a with , he commended Ash and his on their amazing performance, even recommending they enter a Pokémon Contest. May corrected Mr. Big, adding that she was actually for Contests. He taught May about Pokémon Contests, declaring that patience and Pokéblocks were key to becoming a successful Coordinator. Mr. Big gave her a Pokéblock Case and invited them over to his shop to learn to make Pokéblock.

As they arrived at the building, they discovered that had eaten all of the freshly picked Bluk Berries. Mr. Big was disappointed as he needed the berries for his sample fireworks display that night, so May had everyone volunteer to look for some Bluk Berries. Thanks to Torchic, the group successfully retrieved some Bluk Berries. Later that night, Mr. Big was able to showcase his fireworks to the organizing committee as planned, and the group and Drew watched on in awe.
